title: MTA-Zero: Self-Improving Multimodal Deep Search via Online QA-Solver Co-training
abstract: arXiv:2610.33799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have become strong visual reasoners, yet remain limited in open-world, multi-step search that requires grounding images, selecting tools, and integrating web evidence. Existing approaches typically construct and filter fixed offline corpora whose question distributions cannot adapt as the target deep-search agent improves. Building on MTA-Agent's image-grounded QA construction, we present MTA-Zero, an online multimodal QA-Solver co-training framework for self-improving multimodal deep-search agents that requires no precomputed multi-hop corpus. Starting from image-grounded VQA seed contexts, a trainable QA Generator retrieves evidence and constructs verified multi-hop questions online. A separate deep-search Solver then selects tools, gathers evidence, and answers the generated questions. translated_title: MTA-Zero：通过在线问答-求解器协同训练实现自我改进的多模态深度搜索
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已成为强大的视觉推理器，但在需要图像定位、工具选择和整合网络证据的开放世界多步骤搜索方面仍存在局限。现有方法通常构建和过滤固定的离线语料库，其问题分布无法随着目标深度搜索代理能力的提升而自适应调整。基于MTA-Agent的图像定位问答构建方法，我们提出了MTA-Zero，这是一个面向自我改进多模态深度搜索代理的在线多模态问答-求解器协同训练框架，无需预计算的多跳语料库。从图像定位的VQA种子上下文出发，可训练的问答生成器在线检索证据并构建经过验证的多跳问题。随后，一个独立的深度搜索求解器选择工具、收集证据并回答所生成的问题。为了使生成聚焦于求解器的学习前沿，我们为问答生成器推导出一种“恰到好处”奖励机制（原文摘要在此处截断，后续内容不完整）。
tldr: 提出了MTA-Zero框架，通过在线协同训练问答生成器与深度搜索求解器，并利用“恰到好处”奖励机制聚焦求解器的学习前沿，无需预计算多跳语料库即可实现自我改进的多模态深度搜索代理。
en_tdlr: MTA-Zero is an online QA-Solver co-training framework that achieves self-improving multimodal deep-search agents without precomputed multi-hop corpora, using a Goldilocks reward to focus question generation on the Solver's learning frontier.
